question.text: A person of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>80</mn><mo> </mo><mi>kg</mi></math> mass is standing on the rim of a circular platform of mass <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>200</mn><mo> </mo><mi>kg</mi></math> rotating about its axis at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn></math> revolutions per minute (rpm). The person now starts moving towards the centre of the platform. What will be the rotational speed (in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>rpm</mi></math> ) of the platform when the person reaches its centre....
